newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Some prices up on cold.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Some prices up on cold.

text.p: Spring wheat prices in U.S. cash markets were mixed Tuesday with some support coming from weather-related difficulties, merchandisers said.
Bitterly cold temperatures and snow-covered roads in much of the Northern U.S. Plains has shut off both grain movment and selling interest, merchandisers said.
"Pretty much, the weather (snow) and the cold are keeping things slow," said one trader in Minneapolis.
Forecasters show the Northern Plains staying relatively dry, but temperatures were still below zero in some parts of Montana as of 1400 CST, according to data from Weather Express.
Another merchandiser in Montana said that some farmers were not selling because the weather was preventing them from getting to their storage bins.
"There just isn't a heck of a lot of interest out there," said one Montana dealer.
